installer: Bundled uv (Astral, MIT/Apache-2.0) creates each runtime under <app-data>/runtimes/<id>: 'uv python install' fetches a python-build-standalone interpreter, then 'uv pip install --no-deps -r <lock>' installs the exact Windows lock (config/locks/<id>.txt, generated with 'uv pip compile --python-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc' from <id>.in). Local-version suffixes select CUDA builds (e.g. torch==2.8.0+cu128). Git dependencies come from GitHub commit archives; no system Python, Git, compiler or CUDA toolkit is used.
